summary: I found no blocking problems. The `data-testid` values the new tests rely on (`field-*`, `correct-*`, `correct-input-*`, `correct-save-*`) all exist in `CaseReview.tsx`, and the D03-014 fixture exists. The click handler calls `stopPropagation`, so a copy click doesn't select the row. Disabled state for empty values matches the spec. I didn't run the tests. I did not check whether test 3's saved correction to D03-020 persists on the server across re-runs.

findings.message: The 1500ms reset timer is never cleared. Two quick clicks leave the first timer running, so "Copied" can revert early, and a timer can fire after the row unmounts. Keep the timer id in a ref and clear it on re-click and on unmount.

`role="status"` sits inside a `<button>` that has an `aria-label`. The label replaces the button's content as its accessible name, and live regions inside buttons are announced unreliably, so screen-reader users may not hear "Copied". Move the live region outside the button or update the aria-label when copied.
